description.text: 1.Objective: Students in this program receive systematical training in theories, research, design and manufacturing methods of traditional Chinese medicine and natural medicine. Graduates work in such fields as manufacturing, identification and analysis of TCM, as well as pharmacology and biotechnology.2.Degree Requirements: Students in this program spend the first 2 years studying the basic sciences, biology and chemistry courses. In the first semester of the 3rd Year of their undergraduate study, student must choose from different areas of concentration: 1. traditional Chinese pharmaceuticals, 2. analysis of Chinese material medica, 3. biotechnology of Chinese materia medica. Upon graduation, students must have completed core courses, lab courses, practicum and thesis writing.3.Course Offering: Basics Biology &Chemistry Core Advanced MathematicsLinear Algebra Probability& StatisticsPhysicsCollege EnglishLaw Basics Computer BasicsProgramming Language Inorganic Chemistry Analytical Chemistry Organic Chemistry Physical ChemistryBiochemistryMicrobiology Introduction to TCMElementary BiologyPharmaceutical BotanyMedicinal animalsPhysiology and Ecology of PlantsPharmacognosyCultivation of Medicinal PlantsResource of Chinese Medicinal MaterialsMedicinal Chemistry of Natural ProductsPhytochemotaxonomyAnalysis/Biotechnology/Pharmacology /Processing of Chinese Materia MedicaIntroduction to the Development of New TCMPharmaceutical Law 4.Starting Date: September 1 to 5, 2011 Application Deadline: July 15th, 2011 Notes: Those who miss the application deadline can submit your application materials before September 1st, 2011 at the latest.

duration.text: The Traditional Chinese Pharmacy at China Pharmaceutical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of the passport;2. The notarized photocopy of highest diploma and transcripts. If applicants are university students or already employed, they should also provide Certificate of Enrollment or Employment accordingly. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with translations in Chinese or English;3. Chinese Language test report (HSK) for Chinese-taught programs and English language test report e.g. IELTS or TOEFL for English-taught programs;4. A study or research proposal (written in Chinese or English and no less than 800 words);5. Two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English (teacher's signature, contact phone number and email address must be included in the letter);6. Published academic papers or other academic achievements (if applicable).7. Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form.8. Non-criminal record certificate9. Family financial statementThe medical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. The medical examination results will be valid for 6 months. All applicants are kindly requested to take this factor into consideration as they plan to take the medical examination.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese nationals and in good health.2. Applicants are not studying in Chinese universities.3. Education background and age limit:Applicants for bachelor’s degree studies must be high school graduates and be over the age of 18;Applicants for master’s degree studies must have bachelor’s degree and be under the age of 35;Applicants for Doctoral degree studies must have master’s degree and be under the age of 40；4. Applicants should have a competitive academic record.5. Applicants should have strong scientific research ability.
